recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future copy-count semantics should be handled through the active MolecularDefinition or Clinical Genomics work rather than by reviving retired Sequence.quantity wording in core.
issue_request: FHIR-11310 was a Published Clinical Genomics change request for DSTU2 Sequence.quantity, resolved Persuasive, asking to clarify the vague "Quantity of the sequence" wording. The accepted resolution said Quantity means the number of copies of the sequence of interest for RNASeq.
initial_application: Historical commit 5ab7990995a9c5fbfdd33e99aa5e7b2aa72a7816 explicitly applied #11309 and #11310 by changing source/sequence/sequence-spreadsheet.xml so Sequence.quantity used the accepted copy-count wording, with only a spelling typo in "seqeunce".
additional_context: Sequence later became MolecularSequence, and the clarified quantity text was carried into source/molecularsequence/structuredefinition-MolecularSequence.xml. Later Published issue FHIR-36085 simplified MolecularSequence and commit d4613dfa1cd8a5af9a38b68054263deb0c33efc8 removed MolecularSequence.quantity. Current fhir.ini has no active Sequence or MolecularSequence resource, lists Sequence under removed resources, and diagnostics narrative points to MolecularDefinition rather than an active core Sequence/MolecularSequence resource.
reconciliation: No source change was made. There is no current core Sequence.quantity or MolecularSequence.quantity element to update, and reintroducing the retired clarification would conflict with later published cleanup that removed quantity.

related_jiras.note: Historical commit 5ab7990995 applied Sequence.type and Sequence.quantity clarification together, but FHIR-11309 is a separate type wording request.
Published R5 cleanup removed MolecularSequence.quantity after FHIR-11310's clarification had been carried forward.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics issue asking to clarify Sequence.quantity as the number of copies of the sequence of interest for RNASeq.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final historical request and accepted wording for the old Sequence.quantity element.

evidence_items.summary: Commit '#11309 #11310 Revise definition on Sequence.quantity and Sequence.type' changed the Sequence spreadsheet to the copy-count wording.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-11310 was explicitly applied in the then-active Sequence source.

evidence_items.summary: Published MolecularSequence simplification requested removal of quantity; commit d4613dfa1 removed MolecularSequence.quantity and said it removed quantity and readCoverage.
evidence_items.learned: The current absence of a quantity element is intentional later final work, not a missed FHIR-11310 application.

evidence_items.summary: The current resource list has no active Sequence or MolecularSequence entry, Sequence is listed under removed resources, and molecularsequence is commented out in workgroup metadata.
evidence_items.learned: The original Sequence.quantity target is outside current core build scope.

evidence_items.summary: Current Diagnostics narrative says MolecularSequence has been replaced by MolecularDefinition, whose current repeated.copyCount element expresses motif copy count using a different model.
evidence_items.learned: Current implementer guidance no longer depends on the retired Sequence.quantity element.
